text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: service=inference-eu - page fired (high 95th latency). Trigger: 5xx/timeouts > 3m. Please ack and follow incident runbook. https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-latency :rotating_light:

Alex: Acked. I'm on it — joining bridge now.

Jamal: Ack. Seeing a big spike in queued_requests on eu-serving-01, autoscaler kept up for a bit then started throttling. Pulling logs. :eyes:

Tara: I'm reachable, will join in 2 mins. If you need me to take this, ping @Tara.

Alex: Quick check commands:
```
# queue length summary last 10m
curl -s "https://metrics.api/internal/series?metric=serving.queue_length&region=eu&window=10m" | jq .summary
# pod restarts
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=eu-serving -o wide
```

Alex: Logs show repeated 503 from model-worker-2 and increased latency on model variant x-quant. Kernel OOMs earlier? attaching last lines:
```
[13:04:12] model-worker-2 ERROR: kv-cache-miss slow path exceeded 1200ms
[13:04:13] model-worker-2 WARN: dropping request due to max_concurrent_tokens
[13:04:14] autoscaler INFO: scale up event triggered -> +2 replicas
```

Maria: Customer impact: a couple of EU customers reported timeouts, Support ticket INC-4451 opened. No major spike in errors from US. Will message accounts if we need an SLA notification.

ops-runner: PagerDuty escalated to L2 after 2m, current assignee: Alex. Bridgelink: https://zoom.redwood/incident-1765432190

Jamal: Trying a quick mitigation: switch traffic routing to fallback variant (x-quant-fast) for eu region. That should reduce per-token latency but slightly change output. Anyone object?

Tara: Good plan. Do it and add a banner in console. I'll watch for quality regressions.

Alex: Executing route change (command):
```
rbctl route update inference-eu --model x-quant-fast --weight 100 --dry-run=false
```

Alex: Done. Routing updated, new requests show median latency down ~300ms in metrics. Queue depth dropping. :thumbsup:

Maria: Notifying affected customers with a brief note now. Draft: "We observed elevated inference latency in EU region; we routed traffic to a lower-latency model variant to restore service. We're investigating root cause and will follow up." Should I send?

Jamal: Send it. Also add that we're monitoring and share ETA for full restore.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: PagerDuty: acknowledgement recorded by Alex. Status: Mitigation in progress.

Tara: Heads-up — autoscaler logs show one node flapping due to OOM on gpu-driver. I'm spinning up a replacement node pool and cordoning the bad node. Cmds:
```
kubectl drain node-04 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
cloudctl nodepool resize eu-gpu-pool +2
```

ops-runner: Node replacement in progress, should be up in ~6m.

Jamal: Quality checks: ran a small prompt set against x-quant-fast, outputs look within tolerance for top customers. Logging sample-> S3: s3://redwood-artifacts/incidents/1765432190/samples.jsonl

Alex: I'm handing off ownership to Tara — I've got another page. Tara, take primary and keep the bridge. I'll follow up in ops notes.

Tara: Ack, taking ownership. Joining bridge now. Leaving a short runbook checklist in this thread: 1) keep fallback routing; 2) watch queue & med/95th latencies; 3) verify node pool replacement; 4) escalate to infra if node flapping persists.

Maria: I'll create INC-1765432190 in PagerDuty + GH issue and add postmortem template. Assigning to "Tara" for follow-up.

pagerduty-bot: :arrow_up: Escalation notice: On-call rotation advanced to L2 -> Tara. Next: on-call-sre.

Tara: Quick status update: queue depth stable, latency improving, node replacement finished. We'll keep fallback variant until tomorrow morning to be safe. Planning a rolling restart of model-worker-2 in a bit to clear kernel state.

Alex: Thanks all — handing off. Good notes in thread. :pray:

Jamal: thumbs up. I'll stick around for 10 to help if anything spikes.

incident-bot: Incident triage complete for now. Next actions: postmortem, infra follow-up on OOM, and a runbook update to cover variant fallbacks.

Tara: Closing live handover. Will post final status update in 30m.

Maria: I'll flag customer comms for follow-up.

ops-runner: Logged: "mitigation: routed to x-quant-fast; node replacement; rolling restart planned". Closing the bridge in 30 mins if stable.

Tara: final note — no data exposure observed; logs indicate resource shortage. Filing infra ticket INFRA-1122.

Alex: Thanks — great run.
